EL-040.mechanism: Central authors prescribe and audit compliance; deviations are treated as worker failure.
EL-040.mature_form: No immutable general standard; use risk-calibrated constraints within a versioned and reviewable baseline.
EL-040.trigger: NO GENERAL TRIGGER. Safety-critical immutable constraints may exist, but even they require controlled review.
EL-040.native_cheap_path: Use EL-017: a current baseline with explicit exceptions, change rights and review.
EL-040.ceremony_distinction: Standard-work sheets, SOP audits and conformance scores are not proof of capability.
EL-040.criticism: Worker studies link workflow formalisation and autonomy loss to poorer outcomes; mature Lean interpretations describe standards as improvable baselines.

selected_requalification.bearer: Immutable procedure compliance as universal correctness
selected_requalification.scientific_origin: Rejected universal; stable safety constraints remain legitimate
selected_requalification.current_evidence_warrant: S026/S031 challenge coercive practice; legitimate exceptions and changed conditions defeat immutability. Stable constraints may remain unchanged when still valid.
selected_requalification.incremental_control_cost: Revision and coordination burdens can exceed a tiny reversible task.
selected_requalification.qualitative_evaluation_criterion: Permit justified deviation/change at proper authority while preserving still-valid constraints; compliance alone is not an outcome.
selected_requalification.status_semantics: CURRENT_STATUS and EVIDENCE_STRENGTH retain native qualitative labels. They are not new independent qualification or numeric confidence.
selected_requalification.source_role_rule: Historical, normative, empirical, analytical and practitioner roles remain distinct; see exact current access in SOURCES.json. A list headed PRIMARY_SOURCES does not turn doctrine into an empirical trial.

directions.native_receiver_conditions_not_certified: If strict compliance is temporarily necessary: validated hazard case, scope, independent review, override/escalation and expiry.
directions.native_receiver_failure_modes_preserved: Stale procedure, hidden workarounds, deskilling, loss of expertise, coercion and inability to respond to novel conditions.
directions.authority_and_effect_ceiling: A partial datum, constraint or interpretation is not complete warrant, actor authority, observed benefit, causal effect size or an obligation to change action.
directions.control_scope: Exposed finite contrasts establish only their stipulated inference. Native member correspondence remains an authored argument, not a calculation result.
